WHAT TO EXPECT

VEHICLE RECOVERY

Vehicle recovery is part of Square State Towing’s published service offering. Describe the vehicle’s position, access restrictions, damage, and whether any wheels are blocked. The operator needs those details to assess the job; not every recovery can use the same equipment.

Have these details ready

  • Vehicle position and any visible damage
  • Ground conditions and access restrictions
  • Whether another vehicle or obstruction is involved

Before you confirm

Ask about vehicle suitability, current availability, the estimated arrival time, and the total cost. Any extra work or destination changes should be discussed with the operator.

Can every recovery be handled?+

Suitability depends on the scene and equipment required. Describe the situation when you call so the operator can confirm whether the job can be accepted.
